description.value: Heron's Landing is a boutique oceanfront hotel in Campbell River on Vancouver Island, offering rooms and apartment-style suites decorated with European antique décor and private balconies with ocean views. It holds the highest Green Key eco-rating in Campbell River and has 30 units ranging from standard king/twin rooms to two-bedroom penthouse suites with full kitchens. A hot breakfast is included with all room rates, making it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's gateway to adventure.

address.value: 492 South Island Highway, Campbell River, BC V9W 1A5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms a real, active hotel at 492 South Island Highway, Campbell River, BC. Multiple room pages and the extended-stay page reference 'Secure Parking,' 'Garage parking,' and 'Underground parking,' which qualifies as a secure garage arrangement for bikes under the WWC criteria. Free high-speed Wi-Fi and coin-operated laundry are explicitly listed; breakfast with eggs is included in room rates but no early or packed option is specifically mentioned for cyclists.
concerns: Website lists a second local phone number (250-923-2848) not present in OSM tags; OSM only has the toll-free 1-888-923-2849.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel with a confirmed address, website, and phone number. A solid overnight option for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Website lists 'Garage parking' (front page amenities), 'Underground parking' (extended-stay page), and 'Secure Parking' (individual room pages), indicating a secure enclosed garage available to guests

Laundry.detail: Website lists 'Coin laundry' on the front page and 'Onsite coin operated laundry' on the extended-stay page

wow_evidence: highest Green Key eco-rating in Campbell River
